model_name: RansomShield AI Behavioral Classifier (Real Sysmon Telemetry)

features.name: File_Delete_archived
features.description: Sysmon Event 23/26 indicator for file deletion and archiving operations.

features.name: File_created
features.description: Sysmon Event 11 indicator for file creation operations.
features.live_agent_availability: Subscribed via win32evtlog to Sysmon Event 11

features.name: File_creation_time_changed
features.description: Sysmon Event 2 indicator for file creation time alteration (timestomping).
features.live_agent_availability: Subscribed via win32evtlog to Sysmon Event 2

features.name: Pipe_Created
features.description: Sysmon Event 17/18 indicator for named pipe creation and connection.
features.live_agent_availability: Subscribed via win32evtlog to Sysmon Event 17/18

features.name: Process_Create
features.description: Sysmon Event 1 indicator for new process execution.
features.live_agent_availability: Subscribed via win32evtlog to Sysmon Event 1 or psutil process listener

features.name: Registry_value_set
features.description: Sysmon Event 13 indicator for registry key modification.
features.live_agent_availability: Subscribed via win32evtlog to Sysmon Event 13

features.name: process-related
features.description: Aggregate indicator flag for process lifecycle operations.
features.calculation: Aggregated count of process-related Sysmon events in time window
features.live_agent_availability: Aggregated in agent sliding window buffer

features.name: network-related
features.description: Sysmon Event 3 indicator for outbound network connections.

features.name: file-related
features.description: Aggregate indicator flag for file I/O operations.
features.calculation: Aggregated count of file-related events in time window
features.live_agent_availability: Aggregated via watchdog / Sysmon event queues

features.name: suspicious_path
features.description: Binary flag (1/0) indicating process execution from user writable or temporary paths (AppData/Temp/Downloads).
features.calculation: 1 if exe path starts with AppData, Temp, Downloads or Users directory else 0

features.name: system_executable
features.description: Binary flag (1/0) indicating process execution from Windows System directories.
features.calculation: 1 if exe path starts with C:\Windows\System32 else 0

features.name: path_length
features.description: Character string length of the executable path.

features.name: directory_depth
features.description: Nesting depth (count of path separators) of the executable directory.
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated from psutil process path string

features.name: process_name_length
features.description: Character string length of the process binary name.

features.name: process_vs_parent_freq_ratio
features.description: Relative execution frequency ratio between candidate process and parent process.
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated from agent process history table

features.name: executable_depth_diff
features.description: Directory nesting depth difference between parent process and child process.
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated from psutil parent-child process tree

features.name: parent_is_system_executable
features.description: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the parent process is a verified system binary.
features.calculation: 1 if parent exe is in C:\Windows\System32 else 0
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated from psutil parent process inspection

features.name: extension_similarity
features.description: Metric indicating file extension similarity or transformation pattern.
features.calculation: 1 if file rename alters original extension to non-standard suffix else 0
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated from watchdog FileMovedEvent extension delta

features.name: file_name_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of touched file name and path strings.
features.calculation: Shannon entropy calculated on file path strings
features.live_agent_availability: Calculated via Shannon entropy on watchdog file event paths

disclaimer: Metrics represent evaluation on historical Windows Sysmon dynamic analysis telemetry.
